verdict.rationale: cubic documents custom agents as review rules that enforce an organization's own best practices across pull requests. They can be defined in cubic.yaml or adopted from a community library, and they run as part of cubic's automatic review of every new PR. A community comment confirms the rules are written in plain English and kept in the codebase. That comment criticizes the approach as non-deterministic but does not show the feature failing, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documentation that custom agents report as blocking pre-merge status checks that gate merges; first-party examples of checks like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths'; first-party detail on the plain-language rule syntax.
